Comprehensive REST API for managing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), companies, employees, and operational logs with automated text extraction and AI-powered analysis via Google Gemini. SOPs are modeled as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) where steps are nodes and edges define execution dependencies.
